sentences.text: In pursuance of earlier order dated 11.09.2023, applicant and victim are present today before this Court.
They have been duly identified by their respective counsel.
5. Victim categorically states that her marriage was solemnised with applicant and she is not enjoying her matrimonial life.
She also states that she was never enticed by applicant, she went to the house of applicant at her own but her statement was not considered by Investigating Officer.

6. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that victim was willing to enter into marriage with applicant against the wishes of her parents and when she was victimized, she left her parental house,
thereafter, came to the house of applicant.
He further submits that she was advised by applicant about not to do such act but she did not follow the advice.

It is further submitted that due to annoyance, the F.I.R. of the case in question was lodged by parents of the victim and during the course of investigation, she has not supported the prosecution story but by ignoring all these facts,
charge-sheet was filed by Investigating Officer on the ground that she was minor.
It is further submitted that in radiological examination, her age was found 18 years.

It is, thus, submitted that victim and applicant are enjoying their matrimonial life, complainant does not have any objection,
therefore, the proceeding may be quashed.

7. Learned A.G.A. opposes the prayer of applicant and submits that charge-sheet has already been filed by Investigating Officer on the ground that victim was minor but he does not dispute this fact victim has not supported the prosecution story in her statement recorded U/s 161 as well as 164 Cr.P.C.
8.
Learned counsel for the complainant as well as victim jointly requests that the proceedings may be quashed as victim is enjoying her matrimonial life with applicant.

9. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for the complainant, learned A.G.A. and going through the contents of application as well as other relevant documents; it is evident that victim is enjoying her matrimonial life with applicant, hence, there is no possibility of conviction.
In such circumstances, this Court is of the view that the entire proceeding pending against the applicant may be quashed.
10. With aforesaid observations, the present application is allowed and the entire aforesaid proceeding is hereby quashed.
11. Office is directed to release legal remuneration of Mr. Alok Srivastava, learned Amicus Curiae.
